name: Link in bio
looksLike: one small page with all my important links
a stack of links from a social profile
a simple page sending visitors to my other pages
definition: A compact page that introduces a person or organization and gathers a few important destinations, often reached from a social profile.
goal: Help visitors quickly choose a useful destination.
audience: People arriving from a profile or short shared link

sections.name: Identity
sections.purpose: Confirm whose page this is with a short introduction.

sections.name: Priority links
sections.purpose: Put the most important current destinations first.

sections.name: Contact and context
sections.purpose: Offer a contact route and any necessary disclosures.

avoid: Unclear labels such as click here
examples: An artist’s release and contact links

prompts.short: Build a mobile-friendly link-in-bio page with an identity, prioritized descriptive links, and contact details.
prompts.detailed: Build a link in bio website for people arriving from a profile or short shared link. Help visitors quickly choose a useful destination. Include identity, priority links, contact and context. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Descriptive link labels.
